dossiers.thesis_summary: Merger-arb: long AXTA into the all-stock merger-of-equals with AkzoNobel (fixed 0.6539 AKZO per AXTA), signed 18-Nov-2025. Friendly deal; both shareholder votes set 5-Aug-2026; F-4 effective; close targeted end-2026 ("late 2026 to early 2027") gated on antitrust clearance in ~30 jurisdictions incl. the EU Commission (remedies/divestitures in active dialogue). CRITICAL CORRECTION: AkzoNobel pays a EUR 2.5bn pre-completion special dividend to AkzoNobel holders ONLY; Axalta holders receive newly-issued AKZO shares at completion, after that record date, i.e. EX-dividend. Marking to the shares actually received (ex-div AKZO ~EUR 45.7 x 0.6539 x 1.1420 FX) gives fair value ~$34, not the board's $42.64 which valued the cum-dividend AKZO. The real edge is a thin ~4% merger-arb, not a special-situation payoff; R:R ~0.4, not 2.48.
dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing thesis claim is "attractive arb edge." It fails on the live record: once the EUR 2.5bn special dividend (which accrues only to AkzoNobel holders) is netted out, gross upside to deal value is only ~$1.8 (~5%) vs ~$4.2 downside to a standalone break in the high-$20s — an inverted ~0.4 R:R, the opposite of the board's 2.48. Deal is signed/friendly so vote and completion are likely, but the payoff is thin merger-arb carry, and multi-jurisdiction antitrust (EU/China, potential behavioral or divestiture remedies) can slip close into early 2027 or, in the tail, force a break — asymmetric against a 5% gross spread. Fair value is also live-FX sensitive (EUR/USD 1.142; every 1c EUR move ~$0.3/sh).

Correct payoff = 0.6539 x (60.34 - 14.6) x 1.1420 = ~$34.1. Market (AXTA ~$32.3-32.8) corroborates; a $42.64 payoff implies an impossible ~30% spread on a friendly MOE.

dossiers.thesis_summary: Single-asset binary: DURAVYU (vorolanib intravitreal insert) Phase 3 LUGANO topline vs on-label aflibercept in wet AMD, an idiosyncratic company-controlled readout inside a guided window (topline "beginning mid-2026 / this summer," one outlet cites first readout beginning August 2026; twin LUCIA to follow ~Oct/H2). Real, forward-dated, UNFIRED, resolves on trial facts not the tape. Third consecutive positive DSMC review (2026-05-14). Valuation is binary_prob: win price ~$37.5 (within analyst PT range $20-68, median $33) on a de-risked long-acting anti-VEGF; loss price ~$3.0 (single-asset name craters, thin cash/DME floor). Corrected win_prob to 0.45 after verifying the bull's "strictly-more-favorable design" anchor is false.
dossiers.kill_risk: The most load-bearing claim — that Phase 3 is "a cushioned version of a test already passed" — is refuted by population. DAVIO-2 Phase 2 NI success was in PREVIOUSLY-TREATED eyes only (n=160); LUGANO enrolls "previously treated OR treatment naive," and DURAVYU has zero Phase 2 evidence in the treatment-naive (higher-VEGF, harder) segment — precisely where Kodiak's KSI-301 missed NI in DAZZLE. Compounding: management sold ~385k shares under the live ATM in Apr-May 2026 at ~$14.75 (Q1 10-Q Note 8) — dilution INTO the binary, the opposite of a confidence tell; and vorolanib itself missed its PAVIA NPDR primary (2024). If honest win_prob sits at/below market-implied ~0.30-0.35 rather than 0.45, EV collapses toward the tape: at p=0.35, 0.35x37.5 + 0.65x3.0 = $15.08 vs ~$12.88 = ~17% edge — noise on an unbounded overnight-gap binary with a ~-77% loss leg.

dossiers.thesis_summary: The forced-seller catalyst — Prosus compelled to divest its residual ~17% Delivery Hero stake ahead of the EC deadline — RESOLVED on 16 July 2026, when Prosus gave an irrevocable undertaking to tender into Uber's recommended EUR41.50/share cash offer for Delivery Hero (~$14.8bn, DH boards unanimously supportive, taking Uber to ~53%). The forced-selling overhang B13 was leaning against is gone, and it cleared favourably (4.5% to Uber in Apr, ~5% to Aspex in May, 16.8% residual now committed). The event is also immaterial to Prosus: Delivery Hero is ~1.4% of NAV and the incremental premium over Prosus's own live DH mark is ~EUR0.07/share. What survives is a structural, undated ~35% discount-to-NAV value case that is ~79-85% Tencent beta — a value-mandate position, not an event.
dossiers.dated_milestone: 11 October 2026 — EC deadline for Prosus to divest its Delivery Hero stake (extended from mid-August on 2 June 2026 after Naspers' 29 May request); Uber's offer close guided to H2 2027. Both are now RISK dates, not opportunity dates.
dossiers.kill_risk: Uber's offer binds Prosus (irrevocable) but NOT Uber: it is conditional on 50%+1 minimum acceptance, merger-control/BaFin/financial-regulatory clearances, guided to close only H2 2027 — over a year past the EC's 11 Oct 2026 divestment deadline. A deal-break re-opens the forced-sale overhang against an already-once-extended deadline, so 'the edge is spent' carries a wrong-signed residual: not upside, but short-put deal-break risk. Separately, the surviving discount-to-NAV value case is ~80% Tencent (HK) beta — Tencent ~29% below its 52-wk high and under its 200-DMA — i.e. unhedged single-name China exposure, not a floored special-sit.

dossiers.thesis_summary: MP Materials' transformational idiosyncratic catalyst — the DoD public-private partnership (10-yr $110/kg NdPr price-floor contract-for-difference, $400M convertible preferred at $30.03 = ~15% stake, warrant, 100% 10X-magnet offtake) plus the parallel Apple magnet offtake — CLOSED July 10-11, 2025, ~13 months before the board's 2026-06-08 dossier. The event-driven re-rating already occurred (pre-deal ~$25-30 to ~$60 peak, now ~$44.62). The board's binary_prob thesis (win $82 / lose $35, win_prob 0.45) treats a spent catalyst as still live. What remains is a multi-year operational magnet ramp (10X Northlake $1.25B campus, commissioning 2028; Independence 1,000 to 3,000 MT) — not dated, not binary, not idiosyncratic. The name now trades on the NdPr commodity tape and US-China rare-earth geopolitics (the July 2026 ~10-15% slide from $52 to $44 was détente + cooling NdPr + insider selling), which fails B13's 'resolves on its own facts, not the tape' test.
dossiers.kill_risk: My load-bearing claim is 'catalyst FIRED July 2025, edge spent.' Residual risk to that call: MP still has un-fired FORWARD operational milestones (10X groundbreaking, heavy-rare-earth separation buildout at Mountain Pass, potential new large commercial offtakes echoing the Apple deal, and Q2 print Aug 6 2026) that could drive a second re-rating. But none are dated binary special-situation events and any re-rating would be commodity/geopolitics-driven (NdPr spike or US-China re-escalation), which reinforces rather than refutes the reclassification off idiosyncratic event-driven. A genuinely new idiosyncratic catalyst (e.g. a fresh anchor offtake) could still emerge and would need its own dossier.

dossiers.thesis_summary: DBVT is an undated single-binary FDA-approval bet whose resolving event (approval of the VIASKIN Peanut patch, ages 4-7) sits >1yr out (~Q3-Q4 2027): no BLA is filed, so no acceptance and no PDUFA decision clock exist. The only near-term milestone is a company-controlled BLA filing that already slipped from 1H 2026 to Q3 2026 (29 Jun 2026 release, reaffirmed 16 Jul 2026 Q2 update); FDA feedback was presentational (CMC/biostatistical data organization, no additional data requested) but lands on the same manufacturing ground that produced the 2018 withdrawal and 2020 CRL. A mandatory dilutive raise sits in front of resolution -- $174.9M cash at 30 Jun 2026 (into Q3 2027) barely reaches the decision at ~$54M/qtr burn -- and the board's $9.50 floor is unsupported (net cash only ~$2.95/ADS).

The thesis rests on "no dated resolving event + broken floor," and the acceptance leg is genuinely dated-ish (~60 days post-filing) if the Q3 filing holds this time.
